research_question: Owner-approved addition: Best LLC Formation Services: Providers Compared by Real Cost. Verify every product fact and price in the owner draft against official vendor pages.

research_brief.purpose: Owner-supplied editorial draft for llc formation services, fact-checked and fitted to house rules.
